Agentic platform that turns Azure DevOps requirements into production-ready GitHub pull requests with MCP tooling, cutting development time by up to 96%. AI red-team environments for prompt injection and data leakage. Large-scale document comparison systems.

- Teaching Assistant, Duke CS and Math (2025). Four courses, 150+ students a semester. Duke 2025 Outstanding TA Award.

## Marrow Health

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/marrow-health-calorie-counter/id6800819435
- Website: https://marrowhealthapp.com/
- MCP server: https://github.com/skeletonarmytech/marrow-mcp (PyPI: marrow-mcp)
- Calorie counter and Apple Health hub for iPhone, Apple Watch and widgets, built solo in Swift and SwiftUI.
- Open source MCP server plus a hosted OAuth 2.1 relay that lets ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini query 115+ Apple Health data types.
- Release pipeline runs without a Mac on GitHub Actions with fastlane, gated by a 1,590-assertion test suite.
